description: Three-Phase Grid-Connected Electric Vehicles Charging Station with Photovoltaic Panels is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Ioan Viorel Banu (Vasile Alecsandri University of Bacau). Electric Vehicles Charging Station with Photovoltaic PanelsThis dataset contains the model and simulation output results in Matlab/Simulink of a three-phase grid-connected charging station with PV panels for electric vehiicles realized in a work submitted to the 13th IEEE International Conference and Exposition on Electrical and Power Engineering EPEi 2024 (https://www.epe.tuiasi.ro/). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
